name: Securities Settlement
definition: Settlement of the securities in a securities transaction, that is, the instruction to deliver or receive securities, involving the payment of an amount of money or not.

SettlementDate.name: Settlement Date
SettlementDate.definition: Date and time at which a transaction is completed and cleared. |It can be an effective settlement date, that is, payment is effected and securities are delivered or an intended settlement date that is, the date and time at which the amount of money is intended to be moved.

SettlementAmount.name: Settlement Amount
SettlementAmount.definition: Amount of money settled or to be settled.

HoldingsPlanType.name: Holdings Plan Type
HoldingsPlanType.definition: Identifies whether or not saving plan or withdrawal or switch plan are included in the holdings.

SecuritiesMovementType.name: Securities Movement Type
SecuritiesMovementType.definition: Specifies if the movement on a securities account results from a deliver or a receive instruction.

CurrencyToBuy.name: Currency To Buy
CurrencyToBuy.definition: Account servicer is instructed to buy the indicated currency after the receipt of cash proceeds.

CurrencyToSell.name: Currency To Sell
CurrencyToSell.definition: Account servicer is instructed to sell a currency in order to obtain the currency needed to fund the transaction.

DenominationChoice.name: Denomination Choice
DenominationChoice.definition: Denomination (stated value found on financial instruments) of the security to be received or delivered.

SettlementTransactionCondition.name: Settlement Transaction Condition
SettlementTransactionCondition.definition: Conditions under which the order/trade is to be settled.

BeneficialOwnershipIndicator.name: Beneficial Ownership Indicator
BeneficialOwnershipIndicator.definition: Specifies whether there is change of beneficial ownership.

MarketClientSide.name: Market Client Side
MarketClientSide.definition: Specifies if an instruction is for a market side or a client side transaction.

Tracking.name: Tracking
Tracking.definition: Specifies whether the loan and/or collateral is tracked.

LetterOfGuarantee.name: Letter Of Guarantee
LetterOfGuarantee.definition: Specifies whether physical settlement may be executed using a letter of guarantee or if the physical certificates should be used.

EligibleForCollateral.name: Eligible For Collateral
EligibleForCollateral.definition: Specifies whether securities should be included in the pool of securities eligible for collateral purposes.

AccruedInterestIndicator.name: Accrued Interest Indicator
AccruedInterestIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the net proceeds include interest accrued on the financial instrument.

PreConfirmation.name: Pre Confirmation
PreConfirmation.definition: Pre-confirmation of the cash transfer pending the securities transfer, or vice versa.

SecuritiesRealTimeGrossSettlement.name: Securities Real Time Gross Settlement
SecuritiesRealTimeGrossSettlement.definition: Specifies whether the settlement transaction is to be settled through an RTGS or a non RTGS system.

BlockTrade.name: Block Trade
BlockTrade.definition: Specifies whether the settlement instruction is a block parent or child.

SettlementSystemMethod.name: Settlement System Method
SettlementSystemMethod.definition: Specifies whether the settlement instruction is to be settled through the default or the alternate settlement system.

PartialSettlementIndicator.name: Partial Settlement Indicator
PartialSettlementIndicator.definition: Specifies whether partial settlement is allowed.

HoldIndicator.name: Hold Indicator
HoldIndicator.definition: Specifies whether the transaction is on hold/blocked/frozen.

SettlementReason.name: Settlement Reason
SettlementReason.definition: Specifies the reason for the settlement related to the type of underlying trade.

SettlementType.name: Settlement Type
SettlementType.definition: Specifies how the transaction is to be settled, eg, against payment.

BuyInDeferral.name: Buy In Deferral
BuyInDeferral.definition: Specifies if the buy-in transaction was deferred or not.

CashCompensationAmount.name: Cash Compensation Amount
CashCompensationAmount.definition: Amount of money that has to be paid by the failing trading party in case of an unsuccessful or partially successful buy-in transaction.

ForfeitureOfInterestIndicator.name: Forfeiture Of Interest Indicator
ForfeitureOfInterestIndicator.definition: Indicates that bondholders who convert between record date and payable date will forfeit their interest.

TransferOperation.name: Transfer Operation
TransferOperation.definition: Set of processes resulting in a securities transfer.

PartyRole.name: Party Role
PartyRole.definition: Specifies each role linked to the settlement of securities and played by a party at that step in a securities transaction flow.

SettlementQuantity.name: Settlement Quantity
SettlementQuantity.definition: Total quantity of securities to be settled.

SecuritiesTradeExecution.name: Securities Trade Execution
SecuritiesTradeExecution.definition: Specifies the trade which originates the settlement process.

RequestedSafekeepingPlace.name: Requested Safekeeping Place
RequestedSafekeepingPlace.definition: Place requested as the place of safekeeping.

PairOff.name: Pair Off
PairOff.definition: Buy and sell trades are settled in cash, based on the difference in the prices between the off-setting trades.

SecuritiesClearing.name: Securities Clearing
SecuritiesClearing.definition: Clearing process which triggers the settlement process.

Payment.name: Payment
Payment.definition: Specifies the cash payment information of a securities settlement.

RelatedForeignExchangeOperation.name: Related Foreign Exchange Operation
RelatedForeignExchangeOperation.definition: Entry details related to currency exchange information.

Position.name: Position
Position.definition: Information on the quantities and amounts to be settled in a position.

Rollover.name: Rollover
Rollover.definition: Process whereby a financial instrument is reinvested at maturity.

TurnedQuantity.name: Turned Quantity
TurnedQuantity.definition: Relates to a turnaround: the same security is bought and sold to settle the same day, to or from different brokers.
